debugData.name: Alpine boulders (Blender scatter)
debugData.description: showcaseAlpine's boulders (p310 §3.4), the Blender scatter (devTools/blender/buildShowcaseBlocks.py: the template's AekTerrainScatter group over the first splat map's scree) exported with GPU instances in the block's space: the node showcaseAlpineBoulders, its children the instanced copies of BoulderA-C (the toolkit's namaqualandBoulder02, CC0 from Poly Haven, in three shapes, its UVs kept for its own maps). Lossless: a scatter draws its items without their nodes.
